name: Sub
headline: Support Engineer · Datacenter Tech
introduction: I work where hardware, infrastructure and the person using it meet.
My background spans enterprise support, datacenter equipment, networks, identity, collaboration technology and hands-on electronics practice.
The work moves between the wide view and the fine detail: a deployment, a network path, an access problem, or a component on the bench.

roles.title: Senior Desktop Support / Support Engineer
roles.summary: Cross-site support engineering across endpoints, identity, collaboration spaces and executive technology.
highlights: Provide on-site and cross-site technical support across multiple office locations, including white-glove executive support.
Troubleshoot Windows and macOS hardware, software, performance, access and authentication issues.
Support Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook and SharePoint, alongside Okta and Google Workspace identity workflows.
Configure and support Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, AV systems and integrated collaboration technology.
Handle endpoint provisioning, onboarding/offboarding, asset tracking, patching and device lifecycle work.
Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and connectivity issues; maintain SOPs and knowledge-base documentation.

roles.title: Support Engineer
roles.summary: Employee and executive support connecting device provisioning, identity and SaaS operations.
highlights: Triage and resolve complex support issues through ServiceNow and Jira, with detailed escalation notes for engineering teams.
Administer and support Google Workspace, Slack, Okta and Microsoft 365, including provisioning, access and MFA.
Work with JAMF Pro, Apple Business Manager, Okta and FleetDM for zero-touch deployment, provisioning and compliance tracking.
Support YubiKey authentication using FIDO2, OTP and Touch ID workflows.
Provision and ship endpoint devices for new-hire waves; create onboarding documentation and support onboarding/offboarding.
Support Zoom Rooms, AV systems, release/change activity, macOS/iOS updates and white-glove executive technology.
Investigate application errors and service disruptions through logs, system metrics and user reports.

roles.company: Illinois Department of Innovation and Technology (DoIT)
roles.title: Helpdesk, Desktop & Network Specialist
roles.summary: Managed endpoint deployment, network troubleshooting and operational reporting in a multi-site environment.
highlights: Track incidents, assets and CMDB records through ServiceNow and contribute to knowledge-base updates.
Use SCCM/MECM and PXE for zero-touch and batch Windows deployments, with driver packs, BIOS and firmware for Dell, HP and Lenovo.
Support Active Directory, Azure AD, Exchange, Intune and VMware AirWatch provisioning workflows.
Test hardware through thermal analysis, performance benchmarking, crash testing, battery evaluation and feature validation.
Package Windows images and use PowerShell, SQL and Power BI reporting to support administration and system visibility.
Monitor servers, switches, firewalls and hosts through SolarWinds and troubleshoot secure remote access.
Support conferencing, AV, Cisco/Avaya VoIP and SIP equipment alongside Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints.

roles.title: Desktop Support Analyst III
roles.summary: Tier 2/3 desktop, collaboration and connectivity support in a deadline-sensitive legal environment.
highlights: Provide deskside and remote technical support for attorneys and staff, documenting issues and knowledge-base updates in KESM.
Support Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, peripherals, AV and mobile devices through diagnostics, imaging, patching and deployment.
Manage user accounts and memberships through Active Directory and Azure AD, with SCCM, Intune and AirWatch endpoint workflows.
Resolve complex Outlook issues involving PST/OST files, calendar sync, mailbox permissions, delegate access and iManage integration.
Provision and troubleshoot Avaya SIP phones, extensions, voicemail, call groups, VLAN tagging, QoS and one-way audio.
Troubleshoot WLAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN and network connectivity; support secure printing and chargeback workflows.

roles.title: Desktop, Network & Infrastructure Support Specialist
roles.summary: Physical and virtual infrastructure support spanning servers, switching, firewalls, endpoints and datacenter health.
highlights: Track, document and triage incidents through ServiceNow and maintain Confluence knowledge articles.
Support Cisco, Dell, HPE and Supermicro servers, Cisco Catalyst switches and Sophos firewall environments.
Inspect IPMI, iDRAC and iLO health, diagnose HDD/RAM/PSU failures, review logs and coordinate vendor RMA work.
Support firmware/patch updates, asset records, VMware ESXi/vSphere and VM provisioning.
Troubleshoot DNS, TCP/IP, DHCP, routing, NAT and VLANs using Wireshark and SolarWinds.
Support identity, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, endpoint software deployment, VPN services, CUCM and collaboration equipment.
Participate in multi-site migration work and train team members on company technologies.

roles.title: Desktop, Network & Infrastructure Support Analyst
roles.engagementNote: The owner identified subsequent roles as contracts; the employment arrangement for this role has not been further specified.
roles.summary: Level 2/3 support connecting healthcare endpoints, virtualization, directory services and communications.
highlights: Provide Level 2/3 support across endpoints, peripherals, AV, Cisco VoIP, mobile devices and datacenter equipment.
Manage user/account provisioning in Active Directory, Azure AD and Exchange, including GPO, Wi-Fi/SSO and mailbox permissions.
Deploy Windows machines through SCCM/MECM and PXE, including driver packs, BIOS and firmware updates.
Support VMware ESXi/vSphere, VM resources and host/storage alerts; diagnose hardware degradation through SolarWinds, iDRAC, iLO and IPMI.
Support Citrix XenDesktop/XenApp, Cisco CUCM, Cisco AnyConnect and MFA/SSO workflows.
Document recurring issues, share weekly operational updates and apply BigFix remediation work.

roles.title: Service Desk Analyst 3 & Team Lead
roles.engagementNote: No contract or permanent classification was supplied for this role.
roles.summary: Multi-client service desk support and team leadership across healthcare, finance and enterprise environments.
highlights: Provide Tier 1/2/3 support across multiple MSP client environments and identify recurring issues.
Use ServiceNow for incident routing, service requests, change activity and asset/CMDB tracking.
Handle identity provisioning and access through Azure AD, Oracle IAM, SailPoint and Active Directory.
Configure and deploy endpoints using SCCM, VMware Horizon and Intune, including imaging, patching and application deployment.
Troubleshoot Exchange/Outlook, BitLocker, VPN, DNS/DHCP, mapped drives, print servers and logon scripts.
Coordinate documented remote troubleshooting with Field Service Onsite teams before dispatch.
Train and lead a technical support team, manage ticket/call queues and maintain knowledge-base documentation.

roles.title: Desktop Support / Infrastructure Ownership
roles.engagementNote: The initial infrastructure work was full-time. It later became call-based support for issues, patching, upgrades and changes; the transition date was not supplied.
roles.summary: Built the laboratory’s IT infrastructure from the ground up and continues to support it through on-call troubleshooting, patching, upgrades and changes.
highlights: Plan, size, procure and deploy PCs, laptops, printers, servers, firewalls, gateways, routers, switches, telephony, cameras and cabling.
Rack servers/switches, terminate Ethernet cabling and configure VLANs, PoE switches and gateways.
Implement Windows Server 2019 and Active Directory, with provisioning, role-based access and GPOs for laboratory, accounting and operations teams.
Support Wolters Kluwer accounting software and Labsoft, including laboratory equipment connectivity through RS-232/RJ45 integration with the lab server.
Maintain OS, driver, software and firmware updates across endpoints, servers and network devices.
Design and deploy 3CX with Yealink handsets, SIP fax integration and custom print-server queues.
Configure pfSense NAT, port forwarding, VPN access, segmentation, SIP traffic handling and QoS.
Build the company web presence with Drupal and SiteGround; collaborate with external developers on secure patient/doctor laboratory-report delivery.
Coordinate third-party security testing and remediation work, alongside endpoint security management.

cases.title: BUILT FROM THE GROUND.
cases.summary: From initial sizing and procurement to a working laboratory environment, followed by ongoing call-based support.
details: The initial work covered the full IT environment: endpoints, servers, racks, switching, firewalling, cabling, telephony and laboratory connectivity.
Windows Server 2019, Active Directory, VLANs, PoE and pfSense connect laboratory, accounting and operations workflows.
The scope includes 3CX/Yealink voice, SIP fax, custom print queues, and RS-232 laboratory-device integration.
The arrangement evolved from full-time build work into on-call troubleshooting, patching, upgrades and changes.
The company site uses Drupal/SiteGround. Work with external developers on secure report delivery is a separate responsibility.
